subject: Discovery recap + proposed rotating deep-dive windows
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emma Cole <emma@healthspan.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 21:30:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed rotating deep-dive windows

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep-dive that covers architecture, data flow, and compliance gating: 

Summary of what we heard:
- HealthSpan stores PHI across multiple regions and needs strong separation controls (audit logs, KMS integration).
- Primary goal: move inference workload to a private/dedicated deployment with predictable latency under 200ms (95th) for patient-facing features.
- Success metrics: throughput of ~200 QPS during business hours, deterministic tails, and cost target TBD after evaluation.
- Security/compliance owners will expect SOC2 evidence + operational runbooks.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical deep-dive. Because your team spans US/EU/APAC, we suggest running a rotating weekly window so the right technical stakeholders can join without repeatedly asking the same people to jump late-night calls. Below are three slot types we can rotate through (we'll keep the same agenda each week):

- US-friendly (Week A) — Tue 16:00 PDT / 19:00 EDT (engineers: infra + app)
- EU-friendly (Week B) — Wed 15:00 CEST / 07:00 PDT (Europe infra + security)
- APAC-friendly (Week C) — Thu 21:00 SGT / 05:00 PDT (APAC product + ops)

Attached is a simple calendar grid (calendar-grid.png) showing the repeated rotation and a first-draft roadmap we referenced (HealthSpan-Roadmap.pdf). Please pick two preferred slot types so we can seed the rotation and include the right folks.

Agenda (60–90 min):
1) Quick product recap + high-level architecture (10 min)
2) Infra deep-dive: model serving topology, network/egress, KMS, audit logging (30–40 min)
3) Ops & SLOs: batching, latency targets, fallback policies (10–15 min)
4) Qs, next steps, and evaluation plan (10–15 min)

Action items: 
- Emma: pick two preferred slot types (US/EU/APAC) or propose alternatives.
- We'll send a calendar invite series once we have the preferred rotation.

HubSpot link to record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765
Calendly (for quick one-off picks): https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/deep-dive-1-hr

Thanks — happy to adjust. I'm looping Ben and Monica to help coordinate scheduling and bring the right technical SMEs.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: calendar-grid.png, HealthSpan-Roadmap.pdf

Thanks Jonas — this is a helpful recap. Really appreciate the rotating-window idea; that will make it much easier for our distributed team to join consistently.

From our side, the following works as short-list possibilities (will confirm with Carlos and our infra lead Miguel):
- US-friendly: Tue 16:00 PDT (good)
- EU-friendly: Wed 15:00 CEST (prefer Wed afternoons)
- APAC-friendly: Thu 21:00 SGT (possible but prefer Wed/Thu earlier if we can)

Two asks before we finalize: 
1) Can you invite an infra/ops engineer who can speak to KMS/HSM integrations?
2) I've attached a short question set (healthspan-questions.docx) that my security team would like covered if possible.

Also adding my colleague who should join the deep-dive: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@healthspan.co> (Platform Engineering Manager).

If you send the calendar series with the three rotating windows, I'll confirm attendees and we can lock the first session.

Cheers,
Emma Cole
Head of Platform Partnerships
HealthSpan
emma@healthspan.co | +44 20 7946 0958
